---
title: '<div><img src="ohdsi40x40.png"></img> OHDSI GIS WG </div>'
output:
   html_document:
        toc: FALSE
---

<style>
/* Data Inventory explorer. All rules are scoped to #gis-inv so the site theme (cosmo) is untouched. */
#gis-inv{
  --gi-surface:#fff; --gi-fg:#2b3a45; --gi-muted:#62717d; --gi-line:#dde3e8; --gi-hover:#f1f4f7; --gi-soft:#f7f9fa;
  --gi-accent:#2780e3; --gi-sel:#20425a; --gi-p:#2e7d4f; --gi-w:#c08a12; --gi-f:#b23b3b; --gi-n:#cfd7de; --gi-heat:32,66,90;
  --gi-gold:#8a6508; --gi-gold-bg:#f8edcc; --gi-silver:#4f6172; --gi-silver-bg:#e5ebf0; --gi-bronze:#8a4f25; --gi-bronze-bg:#f2e3d7;
  --gi-browser:#5b4d98; --gi-browser-bg:#e9e5f5; --gi-failed:#a33b3b; --gi-failed-bg:#f5dddd;
  color:var(--gi-fg); font-size:14px; line-height:1.45;
}
/* rmarkdown's navbar anchor offset (.section h3/h4 {padding-top:165px; margin-top:-165px}) would pad our headings; our own margins cancel the negative half */
#gis-inv h3,#gis-inv h4{padding-top:0}
#gis-inv .gi-intro{color:var(--gi-muted);max-width:90ch;margin:0 0 14px}
#gis-inv .gi-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){#gis-inv .gi-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
#gis-inv aside{background:var(--gi-surface);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
#gis-inv aside input[type=search]{font:inherit;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:3px}
#gis-inv .gi-facet h4{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--gi-muted);margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:600}
#gis-inv .gi-facet label{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:1px 0;margin:0;font-weight:400;cursor:pointer}
#gis-inv .gi-facet label input{margin:0}
#gis-inv .gi-facet .gi-c{margin-left:auto;color:var(--gi-muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:12px}
#gis-inv .gi-facet label.gi-zero{opacity:.45}
#gis-inv #gi-facets{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
#gis-inv .gi-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
#gis-inv .gi-gh{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gi-fg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gi-accent)}
#gis-inv .gi-gh small{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:400;color:var(--gi-muted)}
#gis-inv .gi-group-r{background:var(--gi-soft);border:1px dashed var(--gi-n);border-radius:4px;padding:10px;margin:0 -4px}
#gis-inv .gi-group-r .gi-gh{border-bottom-color:var(--gi-muted)}
#gis-inv .gi-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;flex:none;display:inline-block}
#gis-inv i.gi-t-Gold{background:var(--gi-gold)} #gis-inv i.gi-t-Silver{background:var(--gi-silver)} #gis-inv i.gi-t-Bronze{background:var(--gi-bronze)} #gis-inv i.gi-t-Browser{background:var(--gi-browser)} #gis-inv i.gi-t-Failed{background:var(--gi-failed)}
#gis-inv .gi-more{font:inherit;font-size:12px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--gi-accent);cursor:pointer;padding:2px 0}
#gis-inv .gi-main{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
#gis-inv .gi-filterbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:13px}
#gis-inv .gi-chip{background:var(--gi-surface);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:99px;padding:1px 4px 1px 9px;display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
#gis-inv .gi-chip button,#gis-inv .gi-clear{font:inherit;border:0;background:none;color:var(--gi-muted);cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px}
#gis-inv .gi-clear{color:var(--gi-accent)}
#gis-inv .gi-total{font-weight:600;margin-right:6px}
#gis-inv .gi-panel{background:var(--gi-surface);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;padding:12px}
#gis-inv .gi-panel h3{font-size:15px;margin:0;font-weight:600}
#gis-inv .gi-ctl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 10px;color:var(--gi-muted);font-size:13px}
#gis-inv .gi-ctl label{margin:0;font-weight:400}
#gis-inv .gi-ctl select{font:inherit;font-size:13px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:3px;background:#fff}
#gis-inv .gi-scroll{overflow-x:auto}
#gis-inv table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;width:100%;margin:0}
#gis-inv th,#gis-inv td{padding:5px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gi-line);text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
#gis-inv th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--gi-muted);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot td.gi-cell{text-align:right;font-family:Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;min-width:44px}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot td.gi-cell:hover{outline:2px solid var(--gi-sel);outline-offset:-2px}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot td.gi-cell.gi-zero{color:var(--gi-muted);cursor:default}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot th.gi-ch,#gis-inv .gi-pivot .gi-tot{text-align:right}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot .gi-tot{font-weight:600}
#gis-inv .gi-pivot td.gi-rh{white-space:nowrap}
#gis-inv .gi-res th[data-k]{cursor:pointer}
#gis-inv .gi-res tbody tr.gi-row{cursor:pointer}
#gis-inv .gi-res tbody tr.gi-row:hover{background:var(--gi-hover)}
#gis-inv .gi-res td.gi-nm{min-width:220px}
#gis-inv .gi-res td:not(.gi-nm){white-space:nowrap}
#gis-inv .gi-res td.gi-nm small{display:block;color:var(--gi-muted)}
#gis-inv .gi-mono{font-family:Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:11.5px}
#gis-inv .gi-tier{display:inline-block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;padding:0 6px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap}
#gis-inv .gi-t-Gold{background:var(--gi-gold-bg);color:var(--gi-gold)} #gis-inv .gi-t-Silver{background:var(--gi-silver-bg);color:var(--gi-silver)}
#gis-inv .gi-t-Bronze{background:var(--gi-bronze-bg);color:var(--gi-bronze)} #gis-inv .gi-t-Browser{background:var(--gi-browser-bg);color:var(--gi-browser)}
#gis-inv .gi-t-Failed{background:var(--gi-failed-bg);color:var(--gi-failed)}
#gis-inv .gi-strip{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;vertical-align:middle}
#gis-inv .gi-strip i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gi-n)}
#gis-inv .gi-strip i.p{background:var(--gi-p)} #gis-inv .gi-strip i.w{background:var(--gi-w)} #gis-inv .gi-strip i.f{background:var(--gi-f)}
#gis-inv .gi-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gi-muted);align-items:center}
#gis-inv tr.gi-det td{background:var(--gi-soft);font-size:13px}
#gis-inv dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content minmax(0,1fr);gap:3px 14px;margin:4px 0}
#gis-inv dt{color:var(--gi-muted);font-weight:400} #gis-inv dd{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#gis-inv .gi-pager{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:8px;color:var(--gi-muted);font-size:13px}
#gis-inv .gi-pager button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;padding:2px 9px;border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:3px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
#gis-inv .gi-pager button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
#gis-inv .gi-note{color:var(--gi-muted);font-size:12px;margin:6px 0 0}
#gis-inv :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gi-sel);outline-offset:2px}


#gis-inv h3,#gis-inv h4{padding-top:0}
#gis-inv .gi-main{gap:10px}
#gis-inv aside{position:sticky;top:12px;max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);overflow:auto}
#gis-inv .gi-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-bottom:-11px;position:relative;z-index:1}
#gis-inv .gi-tab{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gi-muted);background:var(--gi-soft);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-bottom-color:var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;padding:7px 14px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}
#gis-inv .gi-tab:hover{color:var(--gi-fg)}
#gis-inv .gi-tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--gi-surface);color:var(--gi-fg);border-bottom-color:var(--gi-surface)}
#gis-inv .gi-badge{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;background:var(--gi-hover);color:var(--gi-muted);border-radius:99px;padding:0 7px}
#gis-inv .gi-tab[aria-selected="true"] .gi-badge{background:var(--gi-sel);color:#fff}
#gis-inv .gi-tabpanel{border-top-left-radius:0}
#gis-inv{--gi-done:#0b9e94;--gi-catc:#20425a}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg path.gi-catline{fill:none;stroke:var(--gi-catc);stroke-width:2}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg circle.gi-catpt{fill:var(--gi-catc);stroke:var(--gi-surface);stroke-width:2}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-start{stroke:var(--gi-muted);stroke-dasharray:2 3}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg text.gi-start-l{fill:var(--gi-muted);font-style:italic}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-vt{stroke:var(--gi-muted)}
#gis-inv .gi-sw-cat{background:var(--gi-catc);height:3px;vertical-align:3px;border-radius:0}
#gis-inv .gi-hero-l{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
#gis-inv .gi-updated{margin:0;display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;font-size:15px}
#gis-inv .gi-updated span{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;font-weight:700;color:var(--gi-surface);background:var(--gi-sel);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 7px}
#gis-inv .gi-updated time{font-weight:700;color:var(--gi-fg)}
#gis-inv .gi-st-done b{color:var(--gi-done)}
#gis-inv .gi-done{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px dashed var(--gi-n);margin-left:5px;vertical-align:middle;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:#fff;box-sizing:border-box}
#gis-inv .gi-done.on{background:var(--gi-done);border:0}
#gis-inv .gi-legend .gi-done{margin:0 3px 0 6px}
#gis-inv .gi-gby{font-size:13px;color:var(--gi-muted);display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
#gis-inv .gi-gby select{font:inherit;font-size:13px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:3px;background:#fff}
#gis-inv .gi-hero{border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0 0 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gi-soft),var(--gi-surface) 70%)}
#gis-inv .gi-hero-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:16px 28px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){#gis-inv .gi-hero-top{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
#gis-inv .gi-hero .gi-intro{margin:0;color:var(--gi-fg);font-size:15px;max-width:62ch}
#gis-inv .gi-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);gap:4px 26px}
@media (max-width:560px){#gis-inv .gi-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,auto)}}
#gis-inv .gi-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#gis-inv .gi-stats b{font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--gi-sel)}
#gis-inv .gi-stats span{font-size:12px;color:var(--gi-muted);max-width:14ch}
#gis-inv .gi-tierbar{display:flex;gap:2px;height:12px}
#gis-inv .gi-tierbar i{display:block;height:100%;min-width:3px}
#gis-inv .gi-tierbar i:first-child{border-radius:3px 0 0 3px} #gis-inv .gi-tierbar i:last-child{border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
#gis-inv .gi-tierkey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
@media (max-width:860px){#gis-inv .gi-tierkey{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr))}}
#gis-inv .gi-tk{font:inherit;text-align:left;background:var(--gi-surface);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;color:var(--gi-fg)}
#gis-inv .gi-tk:hover{border-color:var(--gi-muted)}
#gis-inv .gi-tk[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--gi-sel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gi-sel)}
#gis-inv .gi-tk .gi-tk-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}
#gis-inv .gi-tk .gi-tk-h b{font-size:18px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#gis-inv .gi-tk small{font-size:12px;color:var(--gi-muted);line-height:1.35}
#gis-inv .gi-hero-note{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gi-muted);max-width:110ch}
#gis-inv .gi-filterbar:empty{display:none}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg path.gi-area{stroke:var(--gi-surface);stroke-width:1.5}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-xh{stroke:var(--gi-fg);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg circle.gi-pt{stroke:var(--gi-surface);stroke-width:2}
@media (max-width:560px){#gis-inv #gi-nb{display:none} #gis-inv .gi-tab{padding:7px 10px}}
#gis-inv{--gi-c-G:#b8860b;--gi-c-S:#3d7cc9;--gi-c-B:#a0522d;--gi-c-N:#7a5fd0;--gi-c-F:#c0392b}
#gis-inv .gi-gsum{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--gi-fg);max-width:70ch}
#gis-inv .gi-gsum b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#gis-inv .gi-seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
#gis-inv .gi-seg button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;border:0;background:var(--gi-surface);color:var(--gi-muted);padding:3px 11px;cursor:pointer}
#gis-inv .gi-seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--gi-sel);color:#fff}
#gis-inv .gi-sw{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:-1px;margin-right:4px}
#gis-inv .gi-gwrap{position:relative;margin-top:6px}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg text{fill:var(--gi-muted);font-size:11px;font-family:inherit}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-ax line{stroke:var(--gi-line)}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-col{cursor:default}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-col:hover rect.gi-seg-r,#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-col.on rect.gi-seg-r{filter:brightness(1.08)}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-hit{fill:transparent}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg .gi-col.on .gi-hit{fill:var(--gi-hover)}
#gis-inv #gi-gsvg text.gi-tot{fill:var(--gi-fg);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#gis-inv .gi-tip{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;background:var(--gi-surface);border:1px solid var(--gi-line);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(32,66,90,.15);padding:7px 9px;font-size:12.5px;min-width:180px;z-index:2}
#gis-inv .gi-tip b{display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
#gis-inv .gi-tip div{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#gis-inv .gi-gtable{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px} #gis-inv .gi-gtable summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--gi-accent)}
#gis-inv #gi-gtbl td{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
@media (max-width:860px){#gis-inv aside{position:static;max-height:none}}
#gis-inv a{color:var(--gi-accent)}
</style>

# **Data Inventory**

<div id="gis-inv">
<header class="gi-hero">
<div class="gi-hero-top">
<div class="gi-hero-l">
<p class="gi-updated"><span>Last updated</span> <time id="gi-asof"></time></p>
<p class="gi-intro">The working state of place-based data discovery: every public dataset assessed so far for linking to where patients live, what has been checked, and what is still open. <a href="https://github.com/OHDSI/GIS/tree/main/exploration/place-data-inventory">Details and roadmap on GitHub</a></p>
</div>
<div class="gi-stats">
<div><b id="gi-s-n"></b><span>datasets assessed</span></div>
<div><b id="gi-s-v"></b><span>verified (Gold or Silver)</span></div>
<div class="gi-st-done"><b id="gi-s-f"></b><span>in the Gaia catalog (metadata and recipe written)</span></div>
<div><b id="gi-s-it"></b><span id="gi-s-itl">iterations</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="gi-tierbar" id="gi-tierbar" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="gi-tierkey" id="gi-tierkey" role="group" aria-label="Tiers: click to filter"></div>
<p class="gi-hero-note">Tiers come from the checks in each row (link, page, licence, unit, years, access). "Page" verified means the facts were read on the publisher's pages; "file" means a real file was opened and its columns, place key and years read. US federal datasets pass the licence check by the working group's rule (public domain unless a page says otherwise).</p>
</header>
<div class="gi-layout">
<aside aria-label="Filters">
<input type="search" id="gi-q" placeholder="Search name, publisher, id" aria-label="Search">
<div id="gi-facets"></div>
</aside>
<div class="gi-main">
<div class="gi-filterbar" id="gi-bar"></div>
<div class="gi-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="View">
<button type="button" role="tab" class="gi-tab" id="gi-tab-breakdown" data-view="breakdown" aria-controls="gi-p-breakdown" aria-selected="true">Breakdown <span class="gi-badge" id="gi-nb"></span></button>
<button type="button" role="tab" class="gi-tab" id="gi-tab-datasets" data-view="datasets" aria-controls="gi-p-datasets" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Datasets <span class="gi-badge" id="gi-nd"></span></button>
<button type="button" role="tab" class="gi-tab" id="gi-tab-growth" data-view="growth" aria-controls="gi-p-growth" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Growth <span class="gi-badge" id="gi-ng"></span></button>
</div>
<section class="gi-panel gi-tabpanel" id="gi-p-growth" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="gi-tab-growth" hidden>
<div class="gi-ctl" style="justify-content:space-between">
<p class="gi-gsum" id="gi-gsum"></p>
<span class="gi-gby"><label for="gi-gspan">Time</label> <select id="gi-gspan"><option value="all">Last 3 months</option><option value="runs">Inventory runs</option></select></span>
<span class="gi-gby"><label for="gi-gby">Stack by</label> <select id="gi-gby"><option value="cat">Category</option><option value="tier">Tier at the time</option></select></span>
<div class="gi-seg" role="group" aria-label="Show"><button type="button" id="gi-gm-n" aria-pressed="true">Count</button><button type="button" id="gi-gm-p" aria-pressed="false">Share</button></div>
</div>
<div class="gi-legend" id="gi-glegend"></div>
<div class="gi-gwrap" id="gi-gwrap"><svg id="gi-gsvg" role="img" aria-labelledby="gi-gsum"></svg><div class="gi-tip" id="gi-tip" hidden></div></div>
<details class="gi-gtable"><summary>Show as a table</summary><div class="gi-scroll"><table id="gi-gtbl"></table></div></details>
<p class="gi-note">The coloured areas are the inventory: each point is one saved run (the master file after that iteration; numbers point to the iterations table on GitHub). Counts are today's datasets present at that run (stacked by their category, or by the tier they had then), so filters on the left apply here too. 3 rows trimmed on 28 Oct are not shown. Under Last 3 months, the dark line before October is the gaiaCatalog itself (dataset folders in its repository, from its git history); it covers the whole catalog, so it shows only while no filter is on.</p>
</section>
<section class="gi-panel gi-tabpanel" id="gi-p-breakdown" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="gi-tab-breakdown">
<div class="gi-ctl"><label for="gi-axr">Rows</label><select id="gi-axr"></select><label for="gi-axc">by</label><select id="gi-axc"></select><span>· click a cell to see those datasets</span></div>
<div class="gi-scroll"><table class="gi-pivot" id="gi-pivot"></table></div>
</section>
<section class="gi-panel gi-tabpanel gi-res" id="gi-p-datasets" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="gi-tab-datasets" hidden>
<div class="gi-ctl"><div class="gi-legend">Checks: <span class="gi-strip"><i class="p"></i></span>pass <span class="gi-strip"><i class="w"></i></span>warn <span class="gi-strip"><i class="f"></i></span>fail <span class="gi-strip"><i></i></span>not checked <span id="gi-chk"></span> <span class="gi-done on" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>in the Gaia catalog</div></div>
<div class="gi-scroll"><table id="gi-tbl"><thead><tr>
<th data-k="n">Dataset</th><th data-k="t">Tier</th><th data-k="lv">Verified</th><th>Checks</th><th data-k="u">Unit</th><th data-k="ly">Latest</th><th data-k="gs">Geometry</th><th data-k="rg">Region</th>
</tr></thead><tbody><tr><td colspan="8">Loading the inventory…</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
